C-SELECTED-CLOSE-BOUNDARY-1-7CADD2ED.Summary: Second of three smaller serial successor slices replacing the superseded `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-REVIEW-CURRENT-BOUNDARY-1-217D3F0D` bundle. Following the current-only CLI policy in `AGENTS.md`, C2 (`.ngrace/changes/archive/C-REVIEW-CURRENT-BOUNDARY-2-6ACE9713`) delivered the review-only slice; this slice binds the selected-close gate behavior and the query change-view phase classifier, and the third slice owns the planning teaching, the footprint, and the README row. It (1) classifies the explicitly selected bundle phase before parsed status can cause an early return and strictly validates a selected archive spec/plan pair with the exported `validateChangeArtifact` and `validateSpecPlanCoverage` plus a local evidence-consumption guard, so a malformed or silently unconsumable selected record refuses before any evidence command or verdict append; (2) preserves all bound criteria evaluation, records each criterion-named evaluation as a direct Verdict child with `Exit` and `Result` children alongside the Verdict's `Finding` and `Ack` children, and adds the selected `plan.xml` bytes to the decision-bearing snapshot and final equality check; and (3) makes `collectChangeView` derive the bundle location from the resolved project's bundle path instead of an absolute-path `changes/archive` substring, so an active approved bundle under a misleading parent keeps active scopes while a genuine applied archive keeps archive scopes. Exactly four paths change across two modules: `M-GATES` (`src/gates/ledger.ts`, the runtime owner, and `src/gates/core.test.ts`, its headerless companion test) and `M-QUERY` (`src/query/change.ts`, the runtime owner, and `src/query/change.test.ts`, its headerless companion test). It reuses the exported grammar validators unchanged and adds no shared-grammar change, no new helper implementation file or export, no warning-output API, and no status/review/catalog change. It declares no `Pays` and makes no governed record-system write; the sanctioned close still performs this bundle's ordinary lifecycle writes. `README.md` is unchanged by this slice (its measured footprint row belongs to the third slice); `examples/` is unchanged.

In `src/gates/ledger.ts` (`M-GATES`), preserve the evaluation and snapshot behavior: evaluate all bound criteria, stop at the first non-zero command within a criterion and continue the remaining criteria, record each criterion-named evaluation as a direct Verdict child with `Exit` and `Result` children alongside the Verdict's `Finding` and `Ack` children, refuse `outcome pass` when a selected command fails, keep the bound finding/ACK/digest behavior, ledger pre/post-write validation and restoration, candidate lock behavior and stale-location/directory/ spec/ledger checks, and add the selected `plan.xml` bytes to the decision-bearing snapshot and final equality check.

In `src/query/change.ts` (`M-QUERY`), derive the change view's bundle location from the resolved project's bundle path rather than an absolute-path `changes/archive` substring, so active approved bundles retain active scopes under neutral and misleading `changes/archive` parents and genuine applied archives retain archive scopes under both, preserving existing query output, absent/ unparseable artifact distinctions, durable-scope states, criterion/verdict tallies, and read-only tree bytes.

C-SELECTED-CLOSE-BOUNDARY-1-7CADD2ED.Problem:
The current-only CLI policy in `AGENTS.md` withdrew historical archive compatibility: older archive contents are passive LLM evidence, not current operational inputs. The superseded predecessor `C-REVIEW-CURRENT-BOUNDARY-1-217D3F0D` was split into three smaller slices. C2 (`.ngrace/changes/archive/C-REVIEW-CURRENT-BOUNDARY-2-6ACE9713`) delivered the review-only first slice; this bundle is the second slice, gates and query, and the third slice owns the planning teaching, the footprint, and the README row.
First, in `src/gates/ledger.ts`, `isAppliedArchiveBundle` (`:541-544`) decides archive phase from an absolute-path `changes/archive` substring and returns false unless the parsed spec status is already `"applied"`, so `evaluateCloseEvidenceChildren` (`:546-584`) returns an empty child list for a missing or unparseable spec or a present non-applied status and never reaches validation. There is no strict selected-close validation at all: `validateChangeArtifact` and `validateSpecPlanCoverage` are not called from `ledger.ts`. An authority probe measured that a malformed/missing spec, wrong wrapper, missing plan and empty `CloseEvidence` all passed the verdict consumer and wrote a ledger without invoking the validator. Classify the selected directory phase before parsed status and validate the selected archive spec/plan pair strictly.
Second, the selected-close verdict consumer never calls the exported validator, so invalid explicit evidence is silently skipped or only its first block runs while the verdict still records `pass`. Two classes are already detected by `validateChangeArtifact` when it is called: a direct empty `CloseEvidence` and a whitespace-only direct `Command` each produce exactly one error-severity `change.close-evidence-incomplete`. Three classes are genuinely uncovered by the exported validator: a legacy `<Criterion>` carrying an explicit `CloseEvidence`, a `CloseEvidence` nested below its `AC-*`, and a duplicate complete direct `CloseEvidence` block on one `AC-*` (the validator inspects only direct `CloseEvidence` children). All five must refuse before commands or append; the first two are answered by calling the exported validator, and the last three require the narrow local evidence-consumption guard in the already-scoped `src/gates/ledger.ts` and its companion test. The guard is not a grammar change and no exported validator is redefined.
Third, the evaluator and snapshot must keep their behavior. The originating anchor is `C-CRITERION-CLOSE-EVIDENCE`'s `AC-EVALUATED-AT-CLOSE` (`spec.xml:478-497`, implemented by `T-003` at `plan.xml:382-405`): one AC-* child per close-bound criterion on the Verdict, with `Exit`/`Result` children, pass refusal on a failed command, and active inertness. The current producer is `src/gates/ledger.ts:572-580`, and the append assembles `Finding`, `Ack`, and criterion children at `:533`. `C-BOUND-VERDICT`'s `spec.xml:1688-1697` is a confirming Assumption that those children remain beside `Finding` and `Ack`, not the originating criterion. `C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-2-C459A20C` established `AC-REVIEW-VERDICT-THREE-PHASE`. All are preserved, and the decision-bearing snapshot gains the selected `plan.xml` bytes so a command-induced plan change refuses append. Refusal preserves the ledger state at the append boundary; command side effects are not claimed rolled back.
Fourth, in `src/query/change.ts`, `isArchivePath` (`:84-86`) tests an absolute-path `changes/archive` substring. An authority probe measured that an active approved bundle under a misleading `changes/archive` parent is wrongly reported archive while both genuine archive controls are correct; the phase bug is one-way. Derive the location from the resolved project's bundle path.

Assumptions.Assumption: The two location decisions can be repaired inside their already-scoped files by deriving phase from `path.relative(root, bundlePath)` against the canonical `.ngrace/changes/active/` and `.ngrace/changes/archive/` directories, without a new helper export and without changing `resolveChangeBundle` or `src/grace-cursor.ts`.

Reusing the exported `validateChangeArtifact` and `validateSpecPlanCoverage` needs no shared-grammar change; if the selected archive path needs a wrapper-identity check the exported validators do not perform, the check stays local to `src/gates/ledger.ts`.

The shipped XML parser counts artifact structure. The post-change population of acceptance criteria, close-bound criteria, `CloseEvidence` blocks, and `Command` identities is measured through the shipped parser after implementation; no post-change figure is projected here.
